about: Screencast production SYSTEM (motion + rules, design-free) derived from Jake's own tutorials: reference 2 (kwysV2smgfY) + refs 3–5 (3Jq-L6uLd28, Geg9TyNoi3w, AZxFgIVgHjg, measured 2026-10-07). Explained in aieditor/screencast/SYSTEM.md. camera.py reads ['camera'], agent_rec.mjs reads ['recorder'] (via env), qa.py reads ['qa']. Colours/cursor sprite/marker colour = STYLE in camera.py, not here. 2026-10-07: Jake's 19-point review of v11 (SYSTEM.md §0) overrides earlier rules: subject centre-middle, constant motion (holds ≤ 6 s), bubble fixed (fades only for actions under it), bubble-first transitions to/from full-screen narration, gradient behind every text overlay.
source: reference-specs/kwys-screencast.json (ref 2, 2026-10-05/06) + reference-specs/sc4-refs2-5.{md,json} (same frame pipeline on refs 2–5, 2026-10-07)

camera.cluster_note: Jake #1/#2 (2026-10-07): each named thing gets its own centred framing — clustering only within 2 s (was 6 s, one framing for a whole list)
camera.moves_budget_note: Jake #2 constant motion (2026-10-07): the 6/min budget (refs' clean moves only) dropped named beats (v12b: the Resize click at 0:23); refs have 17–25 motion events/min
camera.hold_note_round2: ROUND 2 ruling (review D16): no hold > ~3 s without a catalogued move — a ZM10 slow centred push (×1.08 over 46 f, refs ×1.06–1.26 over 24–46 f) starts 1.5 s after the last motion when the gap is ≥ 3 s.
camera.drift_note_round3: ROUND 3 (review N11): rendered drifts were ×1.02–1.04 in 19–23 f (ease tails + alternating push/pull, one outward ×0.96). Now one inward ZM10 push ×1.12 over 42 f (catalogue ×1.06–1.26, D 24–46 f), skipped when the hold cannot fit the whole push.

moves_per_min.note: Jake #2 constant motion (drifts) raised the upper bound; refs 4.7–6.6 moves + 17–25 motion events / min

pans_per_min.note: refs band; Jake's constant-motion rule (2026-10-07) pushes this up — moves inside a zoom are how the camera keeps moving

target_fit_pct.note: framed targets fully in view (the bubble no longer counts: Jake 2026-10-07)

subject_centre_p75.note: raw offset incl. targets at a UI edge (sidebar, top bar) that cannot reach the middle; compliance = centre_excess_p90

centre_excess_p90.note: distance from centre beyond what the page edge forces (camera compliance with Jake #1)

measured_2026_10_07.about: refs 2–5 (sc5 per-frame data, /opt/aieditor-work/reference/work/sc5) re-measured for Jake's review; scripts in the session scratchpad copied to reference/work/sc6/bin

subject_centre_after_move.what: distance of the content centroid (edge-weighted, bubble masked) from the frame centre after zoom-ins/pans, in frame units (hypot of dx/W, dy/H)

static_holds.what: screencast time with no camera move, no cut, no dissolve (854 holds)

dissolve_variant.order: the bubble is gone while the screen dissolve is still < ~40 % (out); in: the screen dissolves in first, the bubble fades in over 3–5 f during its second half
examples: ref5 0:35.80 bubble 23→26 f then screen from f28
ref3 5:19.55 bubble 24→26 then screen from f29
ref5 9:19.83 bubble 22→26 then screen from f29
ref3 0:47.35 7 f linear screen, bubble gone mid-way

text_gradient.what: black→transparent full-width gradient behind ref 2's lower titles and 'Link in the description' (kwysV2smgfY f1720–1822, f13548–13620)
text_gradient.fade_out_curve: norm 1 .96 .74 .34 .15 .07 0 every 2 f from the text exit
text_gradient.spans: starts with the first title (on the cut), stays across back-to-back titles (Hey everyone → I'm Jake Dawson), fades with the last title's exit

transition.note: Jake #5: bubble first, then the screencast. Exit: bubble fades over 6 f from t1−4 f, the screencast dissolves into the A-roll over 10 f from t1. Entry: the screencast dissolves in over 10 f from t0, the bubble fades in over 6 f from t0+5 f. (The refs' 3 f is the ring-blue test's reading; that test reads a true 6 f fade as ~3 f.)
transition.note_loop1: Loop round 1 (review v12 #13): bubble out 4 f ending on the boundary, then a 4 f screen dissolve; entry mirrored. 10 f showed a 50/50 face ghost. TECHNIQUES TR05 order, CUT04/CUT05 ~99 % hard in refs.
transition.end_fade_note: TECHNIQUES TR08: the whole composite fades to black over 30 f (ref 2 11:38.1); a screencast running to the end has no bubble-first exit.
transition.jake_override_of_TR05: Jake rule 5 (2026-10-07): bubble 4 f then screen 4 f — overrides TR05's ~10 f lead + ~8 f dissolve (ref 5 0:35.8), kept as the house setting by the main-session ruling on review D17.
transition.end_fade_from: last word end (TR08 triggers on the last word; review D20)
transition.note_round2: Round 2: screen dissolve 5 f (was 4): with 4 f the per-frame blend step measured 0.56 at one boundary (qa max_step ≤ 0.5); 5 f keeps it 'so fast it isn't noticed' (Jake #5).

text_gradient.note: design-free motion+opacity; colour black. Upper-half overlays get the mirrored (top → down) gradient.

beats.about: Loop round 1 (2026-10-07): scripted word-timed beats. SYSTEM.md §0b R2/R3.
beats.move_lead_ref: TECHNIQUES 'Timing vs words': moves start ~0.8 s before the named word (ref 3, -0.8..+1.35 s)

qa_content.about: screencast/qa_content.py — named subject / brand / garbled-text checks (review v12 root cause 6)
